title: Implement authorized Agent Runtime decision and MessageEnvelope core
verify: Strict unit tests cover all four runtime decisions, every allowed and forbidden decision/claim/safety combination, exact MessageEnvelope v1 fields, safe authorization scope, UUID/timestamp/ref validation, and unknown-field rejection.

Production assembler tests prove an authenticated service-side ActorContext plus plant_id yields exactly the active Plant, latest completed check-in, latest pH row, and latest EC row from PostgreSQL with deterministic ordering and at most four records; callers cannot inject context mappings, payloads, prompts, or source refs.

Integration tests prove the original session/account/membership/Farm/Plant/grant state is reloaded after model execution and before envelope handoff, while ActorContext/session/auth material never reaches the executor or timeline actor_ref.
Archive or revoke during an in-flight invocation downgrades the candidate to audit-only publication_guard_denied, creates no MessageEnvelope, and restore does not replay it.
Silent, invalid-output, provider-failed, publication-blocked, and audit-failed paths expose only stable safe outcomes; timeline append failure returns no envelope handoff.

Exactly one sanitized agent_runtime_decided Timeline Event is appended for each accepted request that reaches execution, and it contains no consumable output, pH/EC value, prompt, provider body, hidden reasoning, credential, session id, auth provenance, or local path.
Production code has no public agent HTTP endpoint, Bus/UI write, mutable agent-run/provider-history persistence, Agno memory/tools/Team behavior, or fake production fallback.
Behavior specs FT-007-BHV-001 and FT-007-BHV-003 trace to named tests; BHV-001 transport/provider evidence completes in TASK-029.
evidence_required: exact input/output schema and decision-matrix test summary
PostgreSQL assembler and caller-injection denial evidence
sanitized timeline payload and audit-failure evidence
focused and full non-real-model regression summaries
purpose: Create the provider-neutral, authorization-sensitive FT-007 runtime core before adding production model composition or Plant bootstrap wiring.
success_outcome: Authorized actual Plant evidence can pass through one project-owned runtime decision boundary into a strict transient MessageEnvelope or truthful audit-only outcome, with fresh current authority and sanitized timeline evidence and without Bus/UI publication or fake runtime behavior.
anti_goals: No provider/model configuration, canonical roster/bootstrap hook, or real-provider dependency in W1.
No public agent HTTP route, BusEventEnvelope, chat/UI Feed persistence, worker, outbox, or FT-008 implementation.
No vision photo input, hydroponics policy, Safety Gate effect, task/follow-up, Companion governance, or dataset behavior.
No provider request/response, prompt, reasoning, session, or agent-run persistence.
No production fake, mock, hardcoded, canned, heuristic, or fallback output.

forbidden_scope: Bus, chat, UI Feed, worker, outbox, or FT-008 implementation
vision, advisor, safety, task, Companion, or dataset product behavior
unredacted auth, provider, path, or hidden-reasoning evidence
stop_conditions: TASK-025-T3-FT-004-W3 is not done or its canonical Plant-operation pH/EC baseline is contradicted.
Exact typed input cannot be assembled through existing ActorContext and PostgreSQL authority without accepting caller-built context.
The fresh post-model guard cannot revalidate the original session/account/membership/Plant/grant identity without exposing auth material.
Correctness would require Bus/UI publication, a new public agent API, or mutable agent-run/provider-history persistence.
Diagnostics or evidence contain credentials, session/auth material, raw provider payload, hidden reasoning, raw chat, unapproved governance content, or local absolute paths.

constraints: Implement the exact strict AgentInputRecordV1 and MessageEnvelope v1 contracts; unknown fields and incompatible decisions/claims fail closed rather than being repaired.
Build production input only from authorized PostgreSQL Plant/check-in/measurement rows and internally derive the exact source-ref set.
Perform provider execution outside database transactions and reload current service-side session/account/membership/Plant/grant authority afterward.
Return envelope_ready only after schema validation, fresh current authority, and successful sanitized timeline append.
Keep test executors behind explicit test dependency injection and absent from production composition.
invariants: Agno/provider output is never runtime authority; project schemas, authorization, and PostgreSQL records remain authoritative.
ActorContext, session provenance, credentials, raw chat/UI, provider history, and hidden reasoning never cross the model-input boundary.
Silent, invalid, failed, archive/revoke-blocked, and audit-failed attempts create no MessageEnvelope or replayable publication candidate.
Timeline is sanitized append-only audit/export and cannot reconstruct or authorize an Agent Runtime decision.
FT-007 envelope_ready is a transient handoff, not Bus/UI publication authority.
verification_targets: Run focused service probes for caller-injection denial, exact typed refs, current authorization recheck, archive/revoke races, safe audit, and audit failure.
Inspect production composition for test executors, canned output, Bus/UI writes, public routes, and provider/prompt/session persistence.
